items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: With my mother sometimes, yeah, we'd speak it.

ctx.x: Did you use this a lot? Did you use this a lot in everyday conversation?

With my mother sometimes, yeah, we'd speak it. Like somebody be sitting around and she didn't want to say something that they want them to understand, she'd break it down and jargon. You know what I mean? Among ourselves, and she'd tell me something that I understand it, you know? You know, the answer that was that, you know?
How about with your friends? No, no. No? Didn't use it?
